Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers

Class CommentController

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers.CommentController
@RestController @RequestMapping("api/v1/storage/comment") public class CommentController extends Object
This controller handles HTTP requests related to comments on storages. It interacts with the CommentServiceManagement to perform operations on comments.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
